card.title: Not Dismissed
card.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

mechanism: A keeps a worker present by insisting that even leaving in a taxi requires A's formal dismissal.
confusable: Unlike adding chores to delay departure, A must treat permission itself as an authority only A can grant.
comparison: D50-a carries the dismissal into the taxi; D50-b carries permission into the space outside a closing cafe.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
